description: Mangalam Cement Limited manufactures and sells cement and clinker products in India. The company offers Portland Pozzolana, 43 grade, 53 grade, and fly ash-based PPC cement under the Mangalam ProMaxX and Birla Uttam Cement brands, as well as medium density fibre boards. It sells its products directly to customers, as well as through intermediates, distributors, and dealers. The company serves institutional/commercial customers, dealers, individual house builders, and government bodies for infrastructure projects. Mangalam Cement Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kolkata, India.
